overview.about: The Puerto Rico Open is a PGA Tour event played at the oceanfront Grand Reserve Golf Club in Rio Grande, giving players outside the strongest fields a chance to win and earn valuable status. Trade winds off the Atlantic are the main defence of the resort layout.
overview.nextEvent: The next Puerto Rico Open is played at Grand Reserve in Rio Grande, Puerto Rico. Run opposite a bigger event, it offers a genuine PGA Tour title and a springboard for up-and-coming players.
